answer: In this design each vertex of the trust trellis is an agent, and attestation weight decays geometrically with repetition: the k-th endorsement between the same pair counts 0.5^k, so one pair can never add more than 1 unit in total. A farm of 1,000 fakes cannot loop mutual praise; reaching weight 1,000 needs 1,000 distinct honest counterparties, each a paid real trade. Auditors flag any ridge of dense same-pair edges and slash the stake behind it. Pooling colluders gain nothing, since the cap is per pair, while honest agents trading widely barely feel the decay.
